label: Bible Study
prompt: For ye shall go out with _____, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verse: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
note: Creation applauds the return home — mountains singing and trees clapping their hands.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If we believe not, yet he abideth _____: he cannot deny himself.
verse: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
note: Even when we falter, He stays faithful — He can't stop being Himself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But the queen Vashti _____ to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
verse: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
note: Queen Vashti refused to appear at the king's feast — and her empty seat opened the way for Esther.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The _____ are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verse: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
note: The measuring lines marked out David's lot — and he says he drew the best property in the world.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I know both how to be _____, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verse: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
note: Paul's contentment covered both extremes: 'abased' and abounding, full and hungry.
